These are the items. Here are the hooks. Drill them.

Twenty-five atomic facts, each anchored to an image and a one-line mnemonic. Five sections, five drills. Work top to bottom; do every drill twice. By the time you reach the bottom, the spine of the exam will be sitting in working memory.

## Section 1 — The 10 dates

Each card is a year, an event, an image, a one-sentence story, and a hook. Read the story aloud. Repeat the hook. Move on.

## Section 2 — The 4 frames

Author, year, claim, hook, deployment trigger. Four cards. The mnemonic for the set: **Bouncers, Both, Mineral, Glue** — Bellin, BMR, Mitchell, Goodarzi.

```{=html}
<div class="frame-card">
  <div class="frame-cite">Bellin · 2004</div>
  <div class="frame-work">The Robustness of Authoritarianism in the Middle East</div>
  <div class="frame-claim">Coercive apparatus determines transition outcomes — regimes survive when their security state has the will and capacity to repress.</div>
  <div class="mnemonic"><strong>Hook:</strong> "Bellin → <strong>Bouncers</strong>." The regime keeps its job because its bouncers — military, security, police — keep theirs.</div>
  <div class="frame-deploy"><strong>Deploy when:</strong> explaining why some Arab Spring uprisings reverted (Egypt, Bahrain) while others transitioned (Tunisia).</div>
</div>

<div class="frame-card">
  <div class="frame-cite">Brownlee, Masoud, Reynolds · 2015</div>
  <div class="frame-work">The Arab Spring: Pathways of Repression and Reform</div>
  <div class="frame-claim">Two predictors of regime survival across the 2011 wave: hereditary executive AND oil rents. Tunisia had neither — and Tunisia transitioned.</div>
  <div class="mnemonic"><strong>Hook:</strong> "BMR → <strong>Both Matter Royally</strong>." Both variables together; remove one and the prediction breaks.</div>
  <div class="frame-deploy"><strong>Deploy when:</strong> any structural-survival question about 2011 outcomes; pairs with Bellin to give two authors on one point.</div>
</div>

<div class="frame-card">
  <div class="frame-cite">Mitchell · 2011</div>
  <div class="frame-work">Carbon Democracy</div>
  <div class="frame-claim">Energy infrastructure shapes politics; MENA is the most-penetrated subsystem of the global energy order.</div>
  <div class="mnemonic"><strong>Hook:</strong> "Mitchell → <strong>Mineral</strong>." Oil-as-mineral shapes politics from the pipe outward.</div>
  <div class="frame-deploy"><strong>Deploy when:</strong> US power, sanctions architecture, structural critique requiring a materialist lens.</div>
</div>

<div class="frame-card">
  <div class="frame-cite">Goodarzi · 2006</div>
  <div class="frame-work">Syria and Iran: Diplomatic Alliance and Power Politics in the Middle East</div>
  <div class="frame-claim">The Iran-Syria alliance is strategic, not sectarian — locked in by mutual threat perception, not Shia identity.</div>
  <div class="mnemonic"><strong>Hook:</strong> "Goodarzi → <strong>Glue</strong>." Iran and Syria glued by strategy, not by sect.</div>
  <div class="frame-deploy"><strong>Deploy when:</strong> any Iran-Syria, axis-of-resistance, or December 2024 Syria-collapse question — inoculates against the lazy sectarian reading.</div>
</div>

<div class="drill-frames" data-drill="frames">
  <p class="drill-prompt">An author appears. Type the year, the claim tag, or the deployment trigger. 8 seconds per item. 4 items.</p>
  <button class="drill-start" data-target="frames">Start drill</button>

## Section 3 — The 4 actors

Each actor has three slots: **Wants**, **Has**, **Cannot**. Memorize the trio. The drill below will ask for any one of them.

```{=html}
<div class="actor-grid">
  <div class="actor-cell">
    <h3>Israel</h3>
    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">Wants</span><span>Security, deterrence, demographic stability, recognition without territorial concession.</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">Has</span><span>Military primacy, US alignment, advanced tech sector, regional intelligence dominance.</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">Cannot</span><span>Move unilaterally to a 1967-lines withdrawal without coalition collapse and security exposure.</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="actor-cell">
    <h3>Palestinians (Hamas + PA)</h3>
    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">Wants</span><span>Statehood (PA framework) <em>or</em> resistance-driven liberation (Hamas) — bifurcated since the 2007 Gaza split.</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">Has</span><span>Moral claim, refugee diaspora, regional public opinion, asymmetric tools.</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">Cannot</span><span>Speak with one voice; the PA cannot crack down on Hamas without losing its own legitimacy.</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="actor-cell">
    <h3>Iran</h3>
    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">Wants</span><span>Forward defense, axis-of-resistance scaffolding, sanctions relief, regional veto.</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">Has</span><span>Asymmetric warfare via proxies (Hezbollah, Iraqi Shia militias, Houthis), oil leverage, geographic depth.</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">Cannot</span><span>Demobilize the axis without losing deterrence; sustain the engine after the December 2024 Syria collapse.</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="actor-cell">
    <h3>Saudi Arabia / Gulf</h3>
    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">Wants</span><span>Regime survival, Vision-2030 economic transformation, Iran balancing, US security guarantee.</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">Has</span><span>Energy and capital, Mecca/Medina legitimacy, the US security relationship, post-2023 China-brokered Iran channel.</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">Cannot</span><span>Sign with Israel while the Palestinian street is mobilized without regime risk.</span></div>
  </div>
</div>

## Section 4 — The 3 throughlines

Three vivid scenes. Walk through each in your head. After each scene, finish the one-sentence version aloud.

```{=html}
<div class="palace-scene">
  <h3>Throughline 1 — The Pivot</h3>
  <p>Picture a literal pivot: <strong>API on the left</strong> (Beirut Summit, 2002 — Crown Prince Abdullah at the podium, twenty-two Arab flags behind him), <strong>Abraham Accords on the right</strong> (South Lawn, September 2020 — UAE, Bahrain, the signed pages on a desk in front of the Truman Balcony). The thing that swung was the <em>price</em> of normalization — from "a Palestinian state" to "shared Iran-deterrence + economic upside." Same actors, same region, inverted sequencing.</p>

The four actors are Nash-locked: each is choosing its best response given the others, so the structure beneath the phases doesn't move. Hammad's word for this: <em>carousel</em>.</p>

    { q: "Iran · Has", a: ["proxies", "hezbollah", "asymmetric", "oil", "geographic", "depth"] },

  ];

  var DRILL_CONFIGS = {
    dates: { items: DATES, seconds: 8 },
    frames: { items: FRAMES, seconds: 8 },
    actors: { items: ACTORS_ITEMS, seconds: 12 }
  };

  var CLOZE_ANSWERS = {
    pivot: ["price of normalization", "price of normalization changed", "price changed", "palestinian state to security and economics", "from palestinian statehood to security", "sequencing inversion"],
    carousel: ["nash equilibrium", "nash-equilibrium", "structure stays", "phases rotate", "structure unchanged", "best response", "actors locked"],
    engine: ["land bridge", "tehran to beirut", "tehran-beirut", "iran's land bridge", "axis", "land bridge severed", "damascus broke"],
    thesis: {

      t2: ["abraham", "abraham accords", "abraham-accords"],
      t3: ["iran"],
      t4: ["damascus"],
      t5: ["december 8, 2024", "december 8 2024", "dec 8 2024", "dec 8, 2024", "8 december 2024", "12/8/2024", "12-8-24"]
    }
  };

  var STORAGE_KEY = "ir362_memorize_missed_v1";

  // ============= UTILS =============
  function norm(s) { return (s || "").toLowerCase().trim(); }
  function matchesAny(input, answers) {
    var n = norm(input);
    if (!n) return false;
    for (var i = 0; i < answers.length; i++) {
      if (n.indexOf(answers[i]) !== -1 || answers[i].indexOf(n) !== -1) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  function loadMissed() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)) || {}; }
    catch (e) { return {}; }
  }
  function saveMissed(state) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch (e) {}
  }
  function shuffle(arr) {
    var a = arr.slice();
    for (var i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      var t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t;
    }
    return a;
  }
  function orderWithMissedFirst(items, drillKey) {
    var missed = loadMissed()[drillKey] || {};
    var missedItems = [];
    var freshItems = [];
    items.forEach(function(item) {
      if (missed[item.q]) missedItems.push(item);
      else freshItems.push(item);
    });
    return shuffle(missedItems).concat(shuffle(freshItems));
  }

  // ============= DRILL ENGINE =============
  function setupDrill(container) {
    var key = container.getAttribute("data-drill");
    var cfg = DRILL_CONFIGS[key];
    if (!cfg) return;

    var startBtn = container.querySelector(".drill-start");
    var stage = container.querySelector(".drill-stage");
    var resultsBox = container.querySelector(".drill-results");
    var timerEl = container.querySelector(".drill-timer");
    var questionEl = container.querySelector(".drill-question");
    var inputEl = container.querySelector(".drill-input");
    var feedbackEl = container.querySelector(".drill-feedback");
    var scoreEl = container.querySelector(".drill-score");
    var restartBtn = container.querySelector(".drill-restart");

    var state = null;

    function startRun() {
      state = {
        items: orderWithMissedFirst(cfg.items, key),
        index: 0,
        score: 0,
        missedThisRun: [],
        timerId: null,
        secondsLeft: cfg.seconds,
        locked: false
      };
      startBtn.hidden = true;
      stage.hidden = false;
      resultsBox.hidden = true;
      nextItem();
    }

    function nextItem() {
      if (state.index >= state.items.length) return finish();
      state.locked = false;
      state.secondsLeft = cfg.seconds;
      var item = state.items[state.index];
      questionEl.textContent = item.q;
      inputEl.value = "";
      inputEl.disabled = false;
      feedbackEl.textContent = "";
      feedbackEl.className = "drill-feedback";
      timerEl.textContent = state.secondsLeft;
      inputEl.focus();
      clearTimer();
      state.timerId = setInterval(tick, 1000);
    }

    function tick() {
      state.secondsLeft -= 1;
      timerEl.textContent = Math.max(0, state.secondsLeft);
      if (state.secondsLeft <= 0) {
        clearTimer();
        gradeAndAdvance(false);
      }
    }

    function clearTimer() {
      if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
    }

    function gradeAndAdvance(submitted) {
      if (state.locked) return;
      state.locked = true;
      clearTimer();
      var item = state.items[state.index];
      var ok = submitted && matchesAny(inputEl.value, item.a);
      if (ok) {
        state.score += 1;
        feedbackEl.textContent = "Correct.";
        feedbackEl.className = "drill-feedback correct";
        // remove from missed list if present
        var missed = loadMissed();
        if (missed[key] && missed[key][item.q]) {
          delete missed[key][item.q];
          saveMissed(missed);
        }
      } else {
        feedbackEl.textContent = "Answer: " + item.a[0];
        feedbackEl.className = "drill-feedback wrong";
        state.missedThisRun.push(item.q);
        var missed = loadMissed();
        if (!missed[key]) missed[key] = {};
        missed[key][item.q] = true;
        saveMissed(missed);
      }
      inputEl.disabled = true;
      setTimeout(function() {
        state.index += 1;
        nextItem();
      }, 1200);
    }

    function finish() {
      stage.hidden = true;
      resultsBox.hidden = false;
      var pct = Math.round((state.score / state.items.length) * 100);
      var summary = state.score + " / " + state.items.length + " · " + pct + "%";
      if (state.missedThisRun.length) {
        summary += "<br><span style='font-size:.85rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--bs-secondary-color);'>Missed: " + state.missedThisRun.slice(0, 5).join(" · ") + (state.missedThisRun.length > 5 ? " · …" : "") + "</span>";
      } else {
        summary += "<br><span style='font-size:.85rem;font-weight:400;color:#2e7d32;'>Clean run.</span>";
      }
      scoreEl.innerHTML = summary;
    }

    startBtn.addEventListener("click", startRun);
    restartBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
      resultsBox.hidden = true;
      startRun();
    });

    inputEl.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
      if (e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        gradeAndAdvance(true);
      }
    });
  }

  // ============= CLOZE GRADING =============
  function setupCloze() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".cloze[data-cloze]").forEach(function(box) {
      var key = box.getAttribute("data-cloze");
      var checkBtn = box.querySelector("[data-cloze-check]");
      var showBtn = box.querySelector("[data-cloze-show]");
      var inputs = box.querySelectorAll("input[data-key]");

      if (checkBtn) {
        checkBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
          inputs.forEach(function(inp) {
            var val = inp.value;
            var slot = inp.getAttribute("data-key");
            var answers = key === "thesis" ? CLOZE_ANSWERS.thesis[slot] : CLOZE_ANSWERS[key];
            if (!answers) return;
            inp.classList.remove("correct", "wrong");
            inp.classList.add(matchesAny(val, answers) ? "correct" : "wrong");
          });
        });
      }

      if (showBtn) {
        showBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
          inputs.forEach(function(inp) {
            var slot = inp.getAttribute("data-key");
            var answers = key === "thesis" ? CLOZE_ANSWERS.thesis[slot] : CLOZE_ANSWERS[key];
            if (!answers) return;
            inp.value = answers[0];
            inp.classList.remove("wrong");
            inp.classList.add("correct");
          });
        });
      }
    });
  }

  // ============= CHECKPOINT =============
  function setupCheckpoint() {
    var btn = document.getElementById("memo-recite-btn");
    var msg = document.getElementById("memo-celebrate");
    if (!btn || !msg) return;
    btn.addEventListener("click", function() {
      msg.style.display = "block";
      btn.style.display = "none";
    });
  }

  // ============= INIT =============
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-drill]").forEach(setupDrill);
    setupCloze();
    setupCheckpoint();
  });
})();
</script>
